subject: W2.b coverage gap in rp8-11
body: GA f-validation test (rp-w2b-questions-per-exam) flagged that rp8-11 each have only 1 W2.b question, while rp1-7 have 3-4. W2.b (parent identification and intercept/transformation calculations) is Kai documented weakness. Design intent (rp6 has 4 W2.b) is to drill this skill heavily. Recommend: add 1-2 more W2.b questions to rp8, rp9, rp10, rp11 to match the rp1-7 standard of 3+. Test currently passes at threshold of 1 to keep suite green while awaiting GR review.
